Class SpinOffProviderAdjustment

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.SpinOffProviderAdjustment
@Component public class SpinOffProviderAdjustment extends Object
Brings the quotes a history connector delivers for a spin-off parent into the basis GT stores: adjusted for the real splits in securitysplit, unadjusted for every recorded spin-off. A source that divided the parent's prices before an action date by the history factor of that spin-off gets them multiplied back: 
g(d) = product of historyFactor(a) over the spin-offs a with history basis ADJUSTED and actionDate(a) > d
close x g(d); open, high, low x g(d) unless the connector stores them as traded; volume unchanged
The method must be applied exactly once per delivered quote, at the place where connector quotes enter GT.
